Gemma, the citizen, was voted out on day one, and Sonnet, the doctor, was killed on night two. On day two, Luna claimed officer, named Terra as a killer, and was voted out after Haiku built a case against her; she was a killer. Haiku, the mayor, was killed on night three, and Sol claimed officer and named Luna while Terra counter-claimed officer and called Sol a killer. The day-three vote tied twice, and Sol was killed on night four, leaving Terra as the last killer alive. The killers won, and Sol's late claim was the big mistake.
